issues.description: Stock.findStockIngredient is specified in the problem statement/UML as `findStockIngredient(String)` (one parameter), but the template repository defines `findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive)` (two parameters). Students following the UML cannot call/implement the method as specified without changing the template API or adding an overload.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the specification by providing `public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name)` as the primary API (as in the solution). Optionally keep the `(String, boolean)` variant as an overload/helper, but ensure all starter-code call sites and the UML/spec consistently reference the one-parameter method.
